spec.title: Pizza · A little order before the oven
spec.description: A cook-along demonstration with an ingredient checklist and a playhead-based timer. Text-led sample recipe.

panels.title: One sample pizza
panels.body: Illustrative home recipe. Oven settings and cooking time depend on your dough and equipment.

panels.title: Film countdown
panels.body: This follows the film playhead. It is not a kitchen timer.

segments.title: Start with the ingredients
segments.summary: Prepare the dough, sauce and cheese before you shape anything. Check off ingredients in Cook along view.

segments.title: Give the dough room
segments.summary: Work on a lightly floured surface. Stretch prepared dough gently and keep the rim a little thicker.
segments.narration: Work on a lightly floured surface. Stretch prepared dough gently and keep the rim a little thicker.

segments.title: Less sauce, more control
segments.summary: Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce. Leave a small border so the rim can rise.
segments.narration: Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce. Leave a small border so the rim can rise.

segments.title: Build a balanced topping
segments.summary: Distribute mozzarella without burying the dough. Keep toppings light enough for the base to bake.

segments.title: Bake, then look closely
segments.summary: Follow the dough recipe and your oven's instructions. Look for a baked base and melted cheese, then finish with basil.
